```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import zscore
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(data_matrix):
    values = np.asarray(data_matrix, dtype=float)

    if values.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("data_matrix must be a 2D matrix")

    n_rows, n_cols = values.shape
    feature_cols = [f"Feature {i}" for i in range(1, n_cols + 1)]

    z_values = zscore(values, axis=1, nan_policy="omit")
    z_values = np.asarray(z_values, dtype=float)

    if z_values.ndim == 1:
        z_values = z_values.reshape(n_rows, n_cols)

    result_df = pd.DataFrame(z_values, columns=feature_cols)
    result_df["Mean"] = result_df[feature_cols].mean(axis=1)

    corr_matrix = result_df[feature_cols].corr()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(6, n_cols * 0.8), max(5, n_cols * 0.8)))
    sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, ax=ax, cmap="coolwarm", center=0, annot=True, fmt=".2f", square=True)
    ax.set_title("Correlation Matrix of Z-values")
    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_ylabel("")

    return result_df, ax
```
